_comment: Skill Repo Spec v1 s9 -- every path in this repo belongs to exactly one class.
TOOL    = code, SKILL.md, docs, reference data, and metrics ABOUT THE SKILL. Public.
FIXTURE = LIFELIKE test data: rows that look like real records, whose real version is
sitting right there in the operator's life and is structurally indistinguishable.
Must be produced by tools/make_fixtures.py -- a real record cannot be regenerated,
so pasting one in fails at commit. (A self-evidently fake canary or an Acme mock is
NOT lifelike and does not need a generator; the risk it guards against is a person
reaching for a convenient REAL example, and there is no temptation to reach for a
real value that would look obviously wrong next to FAKE_CANARY_XYZ.)
DATA    = anything a REAL RUN produced. Never git-tracked. Lives in the private companion
config, resolved at runtime by tools/datadir.py. This repo ships only the schema.
data_sealed = a path that HELD real data, was purged, and must stay dead.
Enforced by tools/data_boundary.py in .githooks and in CI.
_audited: 2026-07-31 RE-AUDIT (supersedes the 2026-07-13 sweep, which recorded an empty declaration for this repo). The earlier sweep asked only whether shipped code appends to a TRACKED file here. That question is too narrow: it clears every path that is gitignored, and .gitignore is advisory -- `git add -f` walks straight through it, which is the whole reason declarations exist. This pass asked instead whether shipped code or shipped docs can put REAL-RUN OUTPUT at a repo-relative path at all. ANSWER: YES, and this is the highest-stakes case in the fleet -- the output is a person's entire Discord history, verbatim, including DMs and forum threads. SKILL.md documents the layout exports/ -> all/, all_json/, organized/, organized_json/ and this repo's .gitignore already names every one of those directories, so somebody foresaw them landing here and then relied on an advisory file to stop it. They are now DECLARED, which makes the seal enforceable. All five are directory-form and therefore owe no .example: there is no single shape to publish for a whole export tree. The exporter writes wherever its -o flag points, so a tripwire at the repo-relative landing site is the only control that does not depend on someone remembering to point it elsewhere.
_data_home: ~/.discord-history-export-config/data/   (override with $DISCORD_HISTORY_EXPORT_DATA_DIR). If this skill ever needs to record real-run output, it goes THERE -- never back into this repo.
